message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts: The defendant Zhang, a lawyer in a law firm, used his position to modify checks, withhold part of lawyer fees, and embezzled funds from the firm's account totaling 94,897.64 RMB. This is a classic case of "职务侵占" (occupying funds using position). In the list, there is "职务侵占" and also "侵占". Which is appropriate? In examples, for similar facts of a person in a position using convenience to take funds from organization, they used "职务侵占". Example: earlier case with Yang (the one about "职务侵占;挪用特定款物") used "职务侵占". Also earlier case "非国家工作人员受贿" used for a non-state employee receiving bribe. Here it's a lawyer (private sector) using position to take funds. That is "职务侵占". Also there is "侵占" as a generic term maybe for non-employee? But "职务侵占" is more specific for employees. The fact says "利用其担任广西昶明律师事务所内某的职务便利". So it's职务侵占. Also there is self-surrender (自首) but not a separate charge. So answer: [罪名]职务侵占<eoa>
